sources.title: statsmodels pinned build, runtime dependency and distribution declarations
sources.author: statsmodels contributors

inspected_anchors.text:
[build-system]
build-backend = 'mesonpy'
requires = [
    'meson-python',
    "cython>=3.0.13,<4",  # Sync with CYTHON_MIN_VER in setup
    "numpy>=2.0.0,<3",
    "scipy>=1.13,<2",
    "setuptools_scm>=9.2.0,<10",
]

]
license = "BSD-3-Clause"
license-files = [ "LICENSE.txt" ]
maintainers = [
    { name = "statsmodels Developers", email = "pystatsmodels@googlegroups.com" },
]
name = "statsmodels"
dependencies = [
    "numpy>=1.23.5,<3",  # released March 2022
    "scipy>=1.8,!=1.9.2",  # released Feb 2022, 1.9.2 blocked due to bug
    "pandas>=1.4,!=2.1.0",  # released Feb 2022, 2.1.0 blocked due to bug
    "patsy>=0.5.6",  # released December 2023
    "packaging>=21.3",  # released Nov 2021
    "formulaic>=1.1.0",  # released December 2024
]
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = [

"pytest>=8.4.1,<10",
    "pytest-randomly",
    "pytest-run-parallel",
    "pytest-xdist",
    "pytest-cov",
    "coverage[toml]",
    "meson",
    'ninja; sys_platform != "emscripten"',
]
doc = [
    # Requirements for doc build, in addition to requirements.txt
    "sphinx",
    # Avoid warnings which break Sphinx by pinning pandas
    "pandas>=2.2.2,!=2.1.0",
    "pydata-sphinx-theme",
    "jupyter",
    "notebook",
    "nbsphinx",
    "nbconvert",
    "pyyaml",
    "pandas-datareader",
    "simplegeneric",
    "seaborn",
    "numpydoc",
    # "theano-pymc; os_name != 'nt'", # disabled because it is not compatible with move recent Python version
    "pymc; os_name != 'nt'",
    "arviz; os_name != 'nt'",
    "jinja2",
    "pickleshare",
    "pytest>=8.4.1,<10",
]
dev = [
    # build
    "cython>=3.0.10,<4",
    "setuptools_scm~=9.0",
    "meson-python>=0.18.0",
    "meson",
    "ninja",
    # run
    "matplotlib>=3",
    "colorama",
    "joblib",
    # Remove due to failures on azure CI
    # cvxopt; os_name != "win32"
    # Pin on Win32
    "pywinpty; os_name == 'nt'",
    # code quality
    "ruff",
]
polars = [
    # Polars support
    "polars>=1.0.0",
]

[project.urls]
homepage = "https://www.statsmodels.org"
documentation = "https://www.statsmodels.org/stable/index.html"
repository = "https://github.com/statsmodels/statsmodels"
changelog = "https://bashtage.github.io/arch/changes.html"
bugtracker = "https://github.com/statsmodels/statsmodels/issues"

[tool.meson-python.args]
setup = ['--vsenv']

[tool.ruff]

fix = false
# Matches requires-python (>=3.10) and [tool.black]'s target-version below;
# also affects which pyupgrade (UP) rules apply.
target-version = "py310"
# archive/ is explicitly documented (archive/README) as deprecated, no
# longer maintained legacy code; excluded so it's not linted as if it
# were part of the active codebase.
extend-exclude = ["archive", "examples/python"]

supported_claims: Selected commit uses mesonpy and dynamic version metadata; source identity is the commit, not an inferred release number.
Build-time constraints and runtime constraints differ; a source build needs the declared Meson/Cython/NumPy/SciPy/setuptools_scm chain.
Runtime dependencies include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, patsy, packaging and formulaic; Python>=3.10. Test/doc/dev/Polars extras are separate.
BSD-3-Clause is declared; actual notices are separately inspected. No complete environment or transitive distribution clearance is granted.
The pinned tree has pyproject.toml and meson.build but no setup.py; its404 is not package unavailability.
limitations: Static original metadata only; no dependency resolver, package build or downloaded tests executed.
Constraint ranges are not a solved lock or a maintenance/SLA guarantee.
